newsitem.title: USA: Falcon Building to explore possible sale.
newsitem.headline: Falcon Building to explore possible sale.

text.p: Falcon Building Products Inc said Monday it decided to explore a broad range of strategic alternatives to enhance shareholder value, including the sale of the entire company or its individual businesses.
It said it retained Merrill Lynch & Co and Smith Barney Inc to give it financial advice.
Chicago-based Falcon manufactures and supplies highly engineered building products serving residential, light commercial and consumer markets.

The Falcon businesses include Hart & Cooley, a manufacturer of air distribution products; Mansfield Plumbing Products, a manufacturer of china, steel and acrylic plumbing products; and DeVilbiss Air Power, a manufacturer of air compressors, pressure washers, portable generators and accessories and tools.
